title: Liquid oxygen made by hand at Alpha Centauri from oxygen gas bought there and sold into the station's bid, docked, no jump
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 09:33 UTC (orders ENT-081, block MERCURY: docked crafting, no trader waits docked; rules F8, F23 (a trader crafts for sale), F12).
